# Playbook: add a page object (or component)
1. Explore the real page (Playwright MCP `browser_snapshot`, codegen, or the `error-context.md` of a failing test). Never guess selectors.
2. Create `src/ui/pages/<app>/<name>.locators.ts` from the template in `src/ui/pages/demo/login.locators.ts`:
   one entry per element, primary strategy by the role → label → … order, `description`, stable `fallbacks`.
   Regions (dialogs, panels) get a second export bound to the region root.
3. Create `<name>.page.ts`: `readonly el = bindLocators(page, NameLocators)`; compose reusable components
   (`DataTable`, `Modal`, `Dropdown`, `Toast`) by passing their root `this.el.<x>.locator`; write business methods
   (`open`, `expectLoaded`, `doSomething`) that return data tests need (ids, references).
4. A widget used on 2+ pages becomes a component in `src/ui/components/<widget>/` (component + locators) and is exported from `components/index.ts`.
5. Register a fixture in `src/fixtures/ui.fixture.ts`.
6. Verify: `npm run lint:locators && npm run typecheck`, then a spec that uses it with `--repeat-each=3 --retries=0`.
